notes.title: Duel with Reality: Release Delayed!
notes.notes:
Dear silver-haired gunslingers (and those who just love shooting each other with humor)!

We faced a tough choice: release the game "as is" or give you truly top-notch content where every shot, every joke, and even your shameful faceplant into a puddle is polished to perfection.

As a certain mustachioed sage from Seattle once said: "A delayed game is eventually good, but a rushed game is forever bad.". We don’t want your duels to feel like a banana fight in socks — so we’re taking a bit more time to fine-tune things.

[h2]What are we improving?[/h2]
🔫 Mechanics — so guns don’t jam at the worst possible moment.
🎭 Humor — because "just joking" isn’t enough for us.
💥 Content — adding even more absurd situations (as if we needed more).

Thanks for sticking with us! We promise: the game will be worth the wait — just like your opponent standing tall before the duel... until you shoot them in the boot.

Stay tuned, and may your aim be ever precise!

P.S. The new release date will be announced soon...

notes.title: 🌊Leaderboard: Who is the Sharpest Duelist on All Seven Seas?🌊
notes.notes:
We’re thrilled to announce a new update that will make your hearts race — the Leaderboard has arrived! Show everyone who’s the true master of the pirate pistol and revolver. Whether it’s a last-second shot or a cold-blooded bluff, every victory you earn will now be etched into the annals of duel history.

[h3]⚔️ What’s New?[/h3]
Track your achievements in real-time among other players.
Fight for the right to be called the richest duelist on all seven seas.
Climb to the top of the rankings and showcase your dominance!

[h3]🔥 How to Reach the Top?[/h3]
It’s simple: win intense duels using your trusty pistol or revolver. Each victory earns you points that boost your position on the leaderboard. The higher you climb, the louder your fame will echo across the waves!

[h3]🎯 Can You Become a Legend?[/h3]
Test your aim, bravery, and tactical mind today! The leaderboard will reveal who among you deserves the title “Cash King.” Don’t forget to share your results in the comments or on social media with the hashtag #DuelantLeader — we’ll be keeping an eye on your achievements!

[h3]💬 Who Do You Think Will Take First Place?[/h3]
Share your predictions in the comments and challenge your friends to a duel to fight for the title of the best! Just remember: on the battlefield, it’s not just accuracy that counts — luck plays its part too.

⚡ P.S.: This is just the beginning for the leaderboard. Stay tuned for more updates — we’ll soon add even more exciting mechanics and events!

[h2]Set sail, mateys! It’s time to prove your name belongs in the history books of pirate duels! 🏴‍☠️[/h2]

notes.title: A big step ❗
notes.notes:
This game was invented by me at the first [url=https://sineys.ru/]SYNEUS hackathon[/url], which took place in Vologda.

The first version was assembled in two days. The experience of participating in other hackathons helped a lot. The first night I slept for about 6 hours, and the second day I did not sleep at all until the end of the work. After sleeping for a couple of hours, I had to present/defend my project.

The project was warmly received by the participants and, by the decision of the jury, became the winner.

I completely rewrote the game from scratch, significantly improving it and will definitely bring it to a full-fledged release.

[b]Become a participant in this story, add the game to your wishlist! =)[/b]
